title: Proposed study collaboration on MPS I

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on mucopolysaccharidosis type I
Dear National MPS Society, MPS Society (UK) and Canadian MPS Society team, each of you supports families affected by MPS I.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea.
Published work describes an alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency in which dermatan and heparan sulfate build up.
The Canadian MPS Registry and a recruiting lysosomal storage disease registry include people with MPS I, and the MPS I Registry study has completed.
Laronidase is approved but does not reach the brain.
An OTL-203 trial compared with stem cell transplant is active but not recruiting.
We would propose [study aim and design], developed with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your community or the Canadian MPS Registry could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
